chapter: Lover Man and the postwar years
title: Piano quartet with puppets at La Vie en Rose
summary: With Sara Lou Harris he joined a four-piano act with puppeteer Frank Paris at La Vie en Rose on 54th Street.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: When do you start to play organ?
Let me see. I worked with Sara Lou Harris... let me see, '55.

Sara Lou Harris. I worked on a puppet show, piano quartet. I was at the (?) with Lionel Meth(?), who was Max Meth's(?) son. Another boy from Louisiana, (?)Wilson DeNiro(?), a (?) pianist. We played at Monte Prose's(?) La Vie En Rose -- I called it Rose Levine.

Four pianos. And puppets. Do you think Henson is the first puppeteer? No, there was some other guy whose name I forgot...Paris, his name was Paris. He was a puppeteer, Frank Paris. And he had this puppets with the piano. Then we had a third or fourth show.
Well, what did you do with these four pianos?
